dimensions.assessment: Affects Foundation employees subject to workforce reductions and entities interacting with or receiving grants from the Foundation.
dimensions.evidence: The United States African Development Foundation... is hereby abolished effective on the date that is 120 days after the date of the enactment of this Act

dimensions.assessment: Completely terminates an independent federal agency and repeals its authorizing statute.
dimensions.evidence: The African Development Foundation Act... is repealed

dimensions.assessment: Directs unexpended appropriations and fund balances to be deposited into the general fund of the Treasury.
dimensions.evidence: Any unexpended balances of appropriations, allocations, or other funds available to the Foundation shall be deposited into the general fund of the Department of the Treasury

dimensions.assessment: Abolishes an entire federal entity, transfers functions and records to the Department of State, and repeals the governing law.
dimensions.evidence: All assets, liabilities, contracts, property, and records of the Foundation shall be transferred to the Department of State

dimensions.assessment: Permanent elimination of the agency, executed through a 120-day wind-down period.

missing_information: Total dollar amount of unexpended balances to be transferred to the Treasury.
Exact number of personnel affected by the reduction in force.
importance_detail.rationale: Abolishes the U.S. African Development Foundation, repeals its enabling act, transfers its assets and multi-year grant oversight to the Department of State, and returns unexpended funds to the Treasury.
